description.zh: 以连接时长作为筛选条件的最小值。
description.en: The duration when the cloud desktop is connected, which is the minimum value for condition filtering.

description.zh: 以连接时长作为筛选条件的最大值。
description.en: The duration when the cloud desktop is connected, which is the maximum value for condition filtering.

description.zh: 以终止连接时间作为筛选条件的最小值。格式为Unix时间戳。单位为毫秒。
description.en: The time when the cloud desktop stops to be connected, which is the minimum value for condition filtering. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 以终止连接时间作为筛选条件的最大值。格式为Unix时间戳。单位为毫秒。
description.en: The time when the cloud desktop stops to be connected, which is the maximum value for condition filtering. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 以开始连接时间作为筛选条件的最小值。格式为Unix时间戳。单位为毫秒。
description.en: The time when the cloud desktop starts to be connected, which is the minimum value for condition filtering. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 以开始连接时间作为筛选条件的最大值。格式为Unix时间戳。单位为毫秒。
description.en: The time when the cloud desktop starts to be connected, which is the maximum value for condition filtering. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.
